review_description: Very helpful with information regarding system as well as process with power companies.
The nominated supplier offered good advice, was quick with returning a quote, had the best value for money from the number of quotes I received and was very helpful through the process.

Jhana was hard to contact at times.  I paid half the cost of the system in early December 2016 and had to really push to get in installed by late February 2017.  I realise that there was the Christmas break and there was a delay on getting the inverters but the lack of communication was not good.  I had to chase him to submit the paper work to the power authority, who I work for, so I could get the system hooked to the grid. If I hadn't I'm not sure how long it would have taken.  I know he is busy but don't take the work on if you can't do it in a timely manner.
Jhana Cowham and the guys at SOLERGY were fantastic to deal with and did an amazing job. I highly recommend them and am extremely happy with my new solar system.
Very good communicator and quick response and installation.
